current_detail: H3-R2.1 is reviewed: 619 loads, 224 rail profiles, all 75 source/pack lines and 2266 legal R2 states reconcile with zero unsafe admission. H3-R2.2 is reviewed end to end: 14 startup/reset/recovery scenarios, 7316 USB/pack/DPM/brownout/source-loss cases, five protected-rail starts, four load-step envelopes and ten watchdog/fault-display cases pass without unsafe admission or automatic restart. H3-R2.3 is current for display, audio, IR, battery and Airband analog corners. Placement/routing, purchasing and fabrication remain unauthorized.

preorder_release.factory_role: deterministic fabrication, population, display mating and final assembly from released files

stages.exit: placement, routed parity, routed electrical/RF/mechanical re-analysis, production outputs and independent DFM/CPL review
